name: Tank cross-section: T-80U turret cheek
description: Cast turret: Kontakt-5 in front (inert), cast steel walls and 'cellular' inserts - two 80 mm polymer-cell layers in alloy shells with 40 mm hollows (polymer stood in by aluminium). Inserts ~815 mm deep. Estimates vs long rods 630-860 mm with Kontakt-5. Approximate reconstruction from public sources (forums, modders' and game reconstructions); real tank armour is secret. Rubber (NERA) and explosive (ERA) layers are empty gaps until those materials are added, so this shape protects LESS than the real thing. Simulated as a 2D vertical slice.
